first_impression.reaction: I searched 'santorini wedding venues' on the train. The page says Greece, not Santorini, but the third sentence is about an Oia terrace and the next one is Athens, so both of my searches get a hit straight away. The takeaways give me the number that actually matters (20 to 60 on Santorini). I'd glance at the table, jump to the Santorini section, maybe the FAQ, then bookmark.

journey.quote: A caldera terrace in Oia suits 40 people. A Riviera resort half an hour from central Athens hosts up to 1,000.
journey.reaction: Two lines and I already know Santorini is small and Athens is big. Exactly the kind of answer I wanted.

journey.quote: Guest count decides the region: Santorini's caldera terraces seat 20 to 60, while venues on the Athens Riviera and in Crete publish space for several hundred.
journey.reaction: This is the one bullet I'd screenshot. Useful, specific, no fluff.

journey.section: Greece wedding venues at a glance
journey.quote: Greece is not one wedding destination but several, and each region asks something different of your guests.
journey.reaction: Then two more sections of how-to-compare before the venues. I'm scrolling past this to find the word Santorini in a heading.

journey.quote: "Not published" means the venue does not state it on its official pages.
journey.reaction: The table is handy but it's six columns, so on my phone I'd be swiping sideways. At least they explain 'Not published' instead of making stuff up. That reads honest.

journey.quote: To check availability, ceremony options and house rules for your shortlist, speak with a Wedded Advisor, who quotes in AUD and works in your time zone.
journey.reaction: AUD? I'm in Singapore. Fine, it's obviously an Australian company, but it makes me wonder if this is for me.

journey.quote: Published ceremony spaces in Oia and Imerovigli seat 20 to 60, so a Santorini cliff-edge wedding suits a smaller guest list.
journey.reaction: Heading matches my search, first line answers the big question. Good.

journey.quote: Canaves Epitome is carved from volcanic rock, and its gardens are the answer for a Santorini guest list of more than 100.
journey.reaction: Ooh, that's the exact thing I'd have asked next. Real venue, real number.

journey.quote: Every wedding needs a wedding planner involved at least three months before the date.
journey.reaction: Didn't know that. Practical and specific, makes me trust the rest.

journey.quote: Not published: room count, curfew, minimum nights, rain plan.
journey.reaction: Every single venue ends with a list like this. Honest, but after the fifth one it starts to feel like the page is telling me what it doesn't know.

journey.quote: Your Wedded Advisor confirms the unpublished house rules for each Cyclades venue in writing for your dates.
journey.reaction: Fine once. But a version of this line closes every region, and by Crete it reads like a sales loop.

journey.quote: For a guest list flying in from Australia, the Riviera has one clear advantage: the airport is close.
journey.reaction: If I came in from 'athens wedding venues' this is the line I want, airport times straight away. The Australia bit isn't me, but the minutes are useful to anyone.

journey.quote: Guest rooms: None listed; guests need a hotel block in Athens and transfers.
journey.reaction: Nice, it actually warns me about the catch.

journey.quote: As at November 2026, services can be delayed or cancelled in bad weather, mainly because of strong winds, and passengers usually carry their own luggage up and down stairs.
journey.reaction: Dated and specific, which is what I check for. The heading says 'from Australia' though, so I'd probably have skipped it.

journey.quote: Santorini, for the caldera and a smaller guest list.
journey.reaction: Straight answer, first word. Love that.

journey.quote: On Santorini, most caldera terraces seat 20 to 60, so 100 guests needs a garden or pool space such as Canaves Epitome's.
journey.reaction: Good, but I had to scroll through the whole country to get here on my phone.

unanswered_questions: Roughly what does a Santorini or Athens venue cost? Even a ballpark. Not a single price on the page.
Is there a jump list? Seven regions, 20 venues, then travel, season, legal and FAQ. I can't skip straight to Santorini or Athens.
Is this service for people outside Australia, or only Australians?

turn_offs_found.quote: Greece is not one wedding destination but several, and each region asks something different of your guests.
turn_offs_found.why: Between the takeaways and the first Santorini heading there's an overview, a how-to-compare section and a six-column table. On a phone that's a long scroll before the bit I searched for, with no jump links.

turn_offs_found.quote: Your Wedded Advisor confirms each Crete venue's house rules in writing.
turn_offs_found.why: The same 'Your Wedded Advisor confirms...' line closes all seven regions. Once is helpful; seven times feels like being sold to.

would_share_with: My friend who's half-planning a Santorini elopement; I'd send her the Santorini section and the 'Is Santorini or Mykonos better' answer

cta_reaction.why: I'm just looking, not planning yet. The links don't get in the way and there are no pop-ups, so they didn't annoy me. I'd bookmark the page before I'd enquire, and the AUD line makes me unsure they'd even work with me.

top_3_changes: Add a short jump list after the Key takeaways linking to each region (Santorini and Athens especially) and the FAQ, so phone readers from a region search can skip the overview and table.
Say the 'Your Wedded Advisor confirms...' line once or twice, not at the end of all seven regions.
Give the 'Not published' lines a lighter touch (fewer items, or only where it really matters such as curfew and capacity) so venue entries end on what the venue does offer.

checks.check: Every journey point and turn-off has an exact quote from the draft
Stayed in character as Priya, a casual Google searcher on a phone
No invented brand facts; missing info went to unanswered_questions
Person-set title, deferred business details and deliberately unprinted prices not treated as must-fix

assumptions: Persona is provisional (weight 0.10); reactions reflect generic informational search intent.
Arrived from 'santorini wedding venues' or 'athens wedding venues', so the Greece-wide title and scope were judged against those narrower queries but not flagged as must-fix.
Prices are deliberately not printed; the missing ballpark is logged as an unanswered question only.
Read on a phone with images not yet loaded; image slots and HTML comments judged as invisible.
Quotes with inline HTML fact comments, link markup or bold markers are given as a reader sees them.
